name: billingo-mcp
description: Official Billingo MCP server: invoices, partners, products, spendings and bank accounts through the Billingo API v3.
long_description: Exposes the Billingo invoicing API (v3) to Claude. Read-only by default: the write tools (issuing, changing, deleting, sending and cancelling documents) are only offered when you turn on "Allow writes" in the extension settings. Claude Desktop keeps the API key in the operating system's keychain, not in a plain-text config file.

api_key.title: Billingo API key
api_key.description: Create one in Billingo under Beállítások → API kulcsok. Its own scope (read or write) is a second gate next to "Allow writes".

allow_write.title: Allow writes
allow_write.description: On: Claude can issue, change, delete, send and cancel (storno) documents. Off: read-only, the write tools are not offered at all.

tool_categories.title: Tool categories (optional)
tool_categories.description: Comma-separated; leave empty for all: organization, partners, products, spendings, bank_accounts, bank_transactions, document_blocks, documents.

confirm_writes.title: Confirm irreversible actions
confirm_writes.description: On: before issuing, cancelling, sending or deleting, Claude Desktop shows you what will happen and waits for your OK. Off: Claude only asks in the chat.
